skills.title: Simple pick-and-place procedure
skills.principle: For a simple pick-and-place goal, decompose the task into two ordered subtasks: first locate and take the target object, then move to the specified destination and put the object down. Keep the two steps sequential: do not begin the transfer until the object has been successfully taken, and do not release it until the destination has been reached.
skills.when_to_apply: When the goal is to move a single object to a specified destination and no additional state change such as cleaning, heating, cooling, or lighting is required. If the goal also requires such a state change, treat this procedure as only the transport portion and handle the extra requirement separately.
